game_rules.win_condition: A player wins instantly upon reaching 20 or more Lore.
game_rules.loss_condition: A player loses instantly if they are required to draw a card from an empty deck.
game_rules.drying_rule: Characters cannot Quest, Challenge, or use abilities that require the Exert symbol as a cost unless they have been in play since the very beginning of the active player's turn. Non-exert abilities are active immediately.

core_verbs.ready: Turn a card upright. It is now eligible to be used for game actions.
core_verbs.exert: Turn a card sideways to pay for an action (Questing, Challenging, Singing, or activating specific abilities).
core_verbs.ink: Placing a card from the hand facedown into the inkwell. Limited to once per turn. Cards must have the inkwell symbol to be inked.
core_verbs.play: Paying the ink cost to move a card from the hand into the active play area.
core_verbs.banish: Moving a character, item, or location from the play area into the discard pile due to damage, challenges, or card effects.

bodyguard.rule: This character may enter play exerted. While this character is exerted, an opposing character choosing to challenge must choose this or another bodyguard character if able.
bodyguard.strategic_coaching_context: Used defensively to protect key questers or engine cards from being challenged. If the player did not exert their bodyguard, it fails to protect the board.

rush.rule: This character can challenge the turn it is played.
rush.strategic_coaching_context: Provides immediate board interaction. It cannot quest or use exert abilities on its first turn, only challenge. Misplay indicator: Playing a Rush unit and passing without challenging an open threat.

evasive.rule: Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.
evasive.strategic_coaching_context: High-value questers that win games by avoiding standard combat. If the opponent has no Evasive characters, these units should quest aggressively.

reckless.rule: This character cannot quest and must challenge each turn if able.
reckless.strategic_coaching_context: Forces combat. Can be bypassed if the active player exerts the character for an ability or a song before the challenge phase.

resist.rule: Damage dealt to this character or location is reduced by the specified number value (e.g., Resist +2 reduces all incoming damage instances by 2).
resist.strategic_coaching_context: Skews combat math heavily. Allows safe 'value trades' where the character takes zero damage while banishing an enemy.

challenger.rule: While challenging, this character gets the specified addition to its Strength value (e.g., Challenger +3 grants +3 Strength only when attacking).
challenger.strategic_coaching_context: Offensive tempo tool. Gives no bonus on defense when being challenged by the opponent.

ward.rule: Opponents cannot choose this character with actions, abilities, or items. It can still be challenged normally.
ward.strategic_coaching_context: Protects against targeted removal or bounce spells (like 'Be Prepared' bypasses Ward because it doesn't 'choose').

support.rule: Whenever this character quests, you may add its Strength to another chosen character's Strength this turn.
support.strategic_coaching_context: Allows small utilities or defensive characters to temporarily punch up into giant threats during a challenge.

singer.rule: This character can exert to sing songs as if its ink cost were the specified number value (e.g., a 2-cost Singer 5 can sing a 5-cost song).
singer.strategic_coaching_context: Massive tempo acceleration. Allows powerful board clears or card draw to happen turns ahead of schedule.

sing_together.rule: Any number of your ready characters can exert to pay the song's cost together, provided their combined printed ink costs meet or exceed the song's cost.
sing_together.strategic_coaching_context: Allows massive, late-game high-cost songs to be played early by tapping down a wide board of low-cost characters.

shift.rule: You may pay the specified Shift cost to play this character on top of another character with the same base name. It inherits the original card's current damage, state (ready/exerted), and drying status.
shift.strategic_coaching_context: Cheats the resource curve. If the underlying character was already dry, the shifted character can quest or challenge immediately, completely bypassing summoning sickness.
